Naina Nair
Talent Acquisition Specialist | Bengaluru
naina.nair725@example.com | +91 9817107322

Experienced talent acquisition professional with a strong background in full-cycle recruitment for technology teams. I combine structured sourcing and stakeholder management with operational expertise in payroll and hiring systems to reduce time-to-fill and improve offer acceptance rates. Comfortable working with Agile product teams and collaborating through Confluence and Git-tracked processes. Notice period: 90 days.

Experience

NimbusSoft — Feb 2022 - Mar 2026
Talent Acquisition Specialist, Remote/Hybrid
- Managed end-to-end Recruitment for engineering and product roles, sourcing candidates via LinkedIn Recruiter and internal pipelines; reduced average time-to-fill from 48 to 32 days and increased offer acceptance to 88%.
- Implemented a standardized payroll onboarding checklist and coordinated with finance to process new-hire Payroll for 120+ hires, cutting first-pay errors by 70%.
- Partnered with engineering leads in Agile squads to plan hiring roadmaps, documenting role requirements and interview rubrics in Confluence and tracking candidate feedback in Git-enabled trackers.
- Ran monthly diversity sourcing campaigns and instituted passive candidate outreach workflows, increasing qualified inbound leads by 40%.

PhonePe — Oct 2020 - Jan 2022
Recruiter, On-site
- Led high-volume Talent Acquisition for merchant and payments teams, closing 85 hires across product and operations while operating primarily through LinkedIn Recruiter searches and pipelines.
- Coordinated with payroll and HR operations to ensure timely onboarding and Payroll setup for new employees, reducing setup time from 10 days to 4 days.
- Designed interview processes aligned with Agile team cadences and maintained hiring documentation in Confluence; contributed candidate status updates and recruiter notes to shared Git repositories for auditability.
- Built targeted sourcing playbooks and referral campaigns that improved quality-of-hire metrics and decreased agency spend by 30%.

Projects
- Candidate Experience Overhaul — Led a cross-functional initiative to redesign candidate communications templates and interview scheduling workflows, resulting in a 25% improvement in candidate NPS.
- Hiring Dashboard — Created a recruiter dashboard using exported Git-tracked metrics and Confluence reports to visualize funnel conversion and time-to-fill by team.

Skills
Recruitment: Recruitment, Talent Acquisition, LinkedIn Recruiter
Operations: Payroll, Confluence
Tools & Processes: Git, Agile

Education
B.Sc Computer Science, St. Xavier's College
